title: PasskeyAttestationVerifyResponse
description: Result of registering a new passkey credential.

registeredAt.description: UTC timestamp when the credential was registered.

nextStep.description: Guidance for the client. 'exchangeLoginTx' only when issueLoginTx=true and loginTx is present.

loginTx.description: Optional login handle to exchange at /auth/token (grantType: 'loginTx').

loginTxExpiresAt.description: TTL hint for loginTx, when present.
